newsitem.title: GREECE: MYTILINEOS TO SIGN DEAL WITH TREPCA MAY 5.
newsitem.headline: MYTILINEOS TO SIGN DEAL WITH TREPCA MAY 5.

text.p: Metals trading company Mytilineos will sign a five-year $517 million contract with RMHK Trepca Mines, General Export and YugoBanka on Monday May 5 at the national economy ministry, it said.
The deal calls for the modernisation of Trepca's mines and the distribution of final product to international markets by Mytilineos.
Its shares rose sharply, gaining 236 drachmas on heavy volume on Friday. They closed at 3,196 in strong demand.
Greek and Yugoslav government officials, bankers and company executives will be present at the signing ceremony, the company said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
